pos.personaBrief: Benfica had a significant share of possession and used it to attack (Coaches' Voice); Flamengo dominated the ball but with vertical, counter-heavy attacks (Hudl). He wants the ball and dominance through it, not giving it away on purpose.

pro.personaBrief: Goalkeeper advanced, build-up from the back (Coaches' Voice, Hudl goal-kick routine), but attack is described as uprightness and vertical progression with fast counters (Hudl, Trivela, Goal).

est.personaBrief: Players crowd the ball side (Trivela), wingers move inside, strikers have total mobility and extreme freedom (Hudl), though a rehearsed 4-4-2 structure exists.

lar.personaBrief: Goal says he likes playing down the sides and won titles that way; full-backs attack and the far side stays wide for switches (Trivela, Coaches' Voice), while wingers also come inside.

blo.personaBrief: Intense press in advanced positions, strikers actively involved, immediate counter-press after losing the ball (Coaches' Voice, Hudl, Goal 2019).

mar.personaBrief: Evidence is mixed: zonal in the sector per Hudl, desire to mark man-for-man per Coaches' Voice, individual matching in the press per Trivela, zonal set pieces per Bola na Rede.

pla.personaBrief: Strong own identity: same 4-4-2 vertical intense model, imposed on arrival (Flamengo started with 4-1-3-2 from Benfica) and kept regardless of opponent; drilled his own model.

res.personaBrief: Stated that winning is not enough, you must entertain (Coaches' Voice); attacking approach, though he did manage a controlled game when ahead in the Carioca final (DN).

sis.personaBrief: Collective approach with a demanding system and defined roles for all, yet great freedom for advanced players like Gabigol and Bruno Henrique (Hudl); everyone must do their function.

jog.personaBrief: Wanted high intensity (Tribuna, Goal), dynamic players; but also valued technical, perceptive players like De Arrascaeta and Filipe Luis, and passing in midfield.

bas.personaBrief: Rarely used academy players (Goal 2019, Record 2014), said no team lives off its academy (2020), Flamengo built with experienced signings like Filipe Luis, Rafinha.

lid.personaBrief: Described as brutish boss, not a father figure, very demanding and without affection (Goal Brasil 2019); authority over caring.
